name: Learning View-Dependent Splatting Kernels
definition: A differentiable framework to automatically learn view-dependent 2D splatting kernels as an implicit representation of volumetric primitives, improving reconstruction quality and representation efficiency for novel 3D view synthesis.
summary: Learning View-Dependent Splatting Kernels is a differentiable framework that learns view-dependent 2D splatting kernels to improve reconstruction quality and efficiency for novel 3D view synthesis.
